home.title: Find events and get your tickets in seconds
home.lead: BiletFlow lets anyone in Kazakhstan publish an event, register guests for free or sell tickets in tenge, and check people in at the door with a QR code.
home.forOrganizersText: Create a free event in minutes. Paid sales unlock after a short activation.

register.title: Create your account
register.done: If {email} can be used for a new account, we've sent a link to confirm it. Open the link to finish signing up.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.success: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.
verify.resent: If that account still needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.done: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.

required.organizer: This page is for organizer accounts.

profile.title: Organizer profile
profile.lead: Attendees see these contact details on your event pages.

payout.title: Payout account
payout.demoNotice: DEMO: no real bank account is connected and no money is paid out. Enter only the last four digits of an account number.
payout.last4Hint: Digits only. Never enter a full account number.

events.title: My events
events.empty: You haven't created any events yet.

manage.cancelText: Every ticket will be cancelled and stop working at the door. Unpaid orders are released. This can't be undone.
manage.unpublished: The event is hidden and registration is paused. Issued tickets still work.

ticketTypes.title: Ticket types
ticketTypes.lead: Free tickets have price 0. Paid tickets need paid sales to be activated.
ticketTypes.empty: No ticket types yet. Add one to publish the event.
ticketTypes.name: Name
ticketTypes.hiddenHint: Hidden tickets aren't shown or sold, but keep their orders.

activation.title: Paid sales
activation.lead: Complete every step to sell paid tickets for this event. Free tickets work without this.
activation.demoNotice: DEMO: identity checks, payout accounts and the activation fee are all simulated. No documents are collected and no money moves.
activation.enabled: Paid sales are on. Attendees can buy paid tickets.
activation.suspended: Paid sales for this event are suspended. Contact BiletFlow support.

paidTicket.title: Paid ticket type
paidTicket.text: Add at least one ticket type with a price above 0.

identity.title: Identity check
identity.text: A simulated check for the demo. No documents are uploaded.

payout.title: Payout account
payout.text: Connect the payout account from your organizer profile.

fee.title: Activation fee
fee.text: One-time fee for this event: {amount}. Non-refundable.

terms.title: Paid-event terms
terms.text: You agree to deliver the event and handle refunds under your policy.

activation.feeFailed: The DEMO payment failed. Try again.

staff.title: Check-in staff
staff.lead: People you add can sign in to the BiletFlow Scanner app and check attendees in at this event only. They need a BiletFlow account first.

preview.banner: Preview: this is how attendees will see the page.

form.title: Title
form.timezoneHint: Times are entered in this time zone.
form.draftNotice: Drafts are only visible to you.

visibilityOptions.unlisted: Unlisted: only people with the link
visibilityOptions.private: Private: only you and your staff

form.registrationHint: Leave empty to open now and close when the event ends.
form.capacityHint: Total tickets across all types. Leave empty for no limit.

view.paidNotEnabled: Paid tickets aren't on sale yet.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach BiletFlow. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has already been used.
errors.token_expired: This link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.event_not_editable: Cancelled or completed events can't be edited.
errors.invalid_event_times: The event must end after it starts.
errors.payout_account_not_found: You haven't set up a payout account yet.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.no_ticket_types: Add at least one visible ticket type before publishing.
errors.email_not_verified: Confirm your email address before publishing.
errors.invalid_status_transition: That action isn't possible for this event right now.
errors.capacity_below_sold: The capacity can't be lower than the tickets already sold or reserved.
errors.invalid_registration_window: Registration must close after it opens.
errors.quantity_below_sold: The quantity can't be lower than the tickets already sold or reserved.
errors.ticket_type_has_orders: This ticket type has orders. Hide it instead of deleting it.
errors.invalid_sales_window: Sales must end after they start.
errors.payout_account_required: Set up your payout account in your profile first.
errors.activation_fee_already_paid: The activation fee is already paid.
errors.idempotency_key_reused: This payment was already submitted. Refresh and try again.
errors.user_not_found: No active BiletFlow account uses that email. Ask them to register first.
errors.already_assigned: This person is already on the staff.
errors.staff_not_found: That staff member was not found.
errors.paid_sales_not_active: Paid tickets for this event aren't on sale yet.
